title: Ethanol dry reforming into synthesis gas: effect of oxygen mobility and reactivity
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4554-4587
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00359H, Review Article
Nikita F. Eremeev, Semon A. Hanna, Vladislav A. Sadykov, Yuliya N. Bespalko
Ethanol dry reforming for H2 and syngas production requires efficient catalysts with high oxygen mobility which plays a crucial role in their activity and coking stability. It can be implemented in SOFC, membrane reactors, piston engines, etc.
